metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: Premium solar energy solutions and turnkey construction services.

work_process.title: Key Services
work_process.description: Complete engineering, construction and project management in Bulgaria and abroad.
work_process.intro_left: We offer services designed to transform energy projects into secure, efficient, and long-term solutions. Combining real-world experience, technical expertise, and strong organization, we execute every stage with a clear goal – maximum value for the client.
work_process.intro_right: We work quickly, precisely, and responsibly because we know that quality is not just a standard, but a promise. Our team builds photovoltaic installations with sustainability, reliability, and optimal performance in mind, creating partnerships based on trust and results.

steps.ground_desc: We build ground-mounted photovoltaic installations focusing on stability, efficiency, and quality execution, in accordance with applicable international standards and project specifics. Our team ensures precise installation of static and tracker structures and photovoltaic modules, adapted to site conditions, to guarantee maximum performance and long-term system reliability.
steps.rooftop_desc: We implement rooftop solar solutions that turn unused areas into effective energy assets. We work with attention to safety and building specifics to ensure secure operation and high energy return.
steps.carport_desc: We build solar carports that combine functionality with sustainable energy production. These systems provide protection for vehicles while simultaneously generating electricity, adding value to infrastructure and improving site energy efficiency.
steps.floating_desc: We implement floating photovoltaic systems that utilize water surfaces for efficient clean energy production. Our approach ensures platform stability, resistance to external conditions, and optimal performance, expanding opportunities for solar project development.

key_services.title: Technologies
key_services.description: We apply established and high-efficiency installation technologies in the construction of photovoltaic power plants, guided by the project's technical requirements, terrain specifics, and applicable European standards. Our approach ensures reliability, long-term operation, and optimal performance of the installations.

fixed_tilt.title: Fixed Tilt Systems
fixed_tilt.description: Construction of photovoltaic structures with fixed tilt and proven stability.
list: Characterized by technological reliability and high economic efficiency.
The technology is widely applicable for large utility-scale energy projects.
Ensures predictable results with minimal maintenance costs.

tracker.title: Tracker Systems
tracker.description: Installation of single-axis tracking systems designed to follow solar movement.
list: Installation is performed with a high degree of precision.
Guaranteeing correct alignment and mechanical stability.
Compliance with the manufacturer's technical documentation.

agrivoltaic.title: Agri-PV Installations
agrivoltaic.description: Implementation of projects combining efficient photovoltaic production and active agricultural activity.
list: The technology allows full utilization of areas and sustainable development.
We apply experienced teams, structured processes, and technological expertise.
We execute complex projects according to the requirements of international clients.

bess.title: BESS – Battery Energy Storage Systems
bess.description: Installation of energy storage systems as integrated or standalone solutions.
list: We perform specialized installation of containerized battery modules and systems.
We provide the necessary auxiliary infrastructure and full electrical integration.
Safety, reliability, and energy flow management are priorities.

installation_types.title: Types of Installations and Technologies
installation_types.description: We offer a wide range of solar solutions tailored to your specific needs and terrain conditions.
